title: veridict verify-run manifest
description: Manifest for veridict verify-run: declares the expected structure and identifiers of an evaluation run. Embeds the 14 fields from experiment-envelope.schema.json directly in a flat document and adds verification settings. Supported identifiers are compared with per-record declarations in verify-run-record.schema.json; artifact files are never opened, hashed, or authenticated. additionalProperties is false so an unknown key cannot silently disable an intended check.

manifest_schema_version.description: Versions this manifest's own (non-envelope) shape. A mismatch against the version this veridict build supports is a hard error (exit 3, no report produced) - distinct from a violation, since an unrecognized manifest shape can't be safely checked at all. Currently 1.

experiment_id.description: See experiment-envelope.schema.json. Drives the experiment_contamination check.

dataset_sha256.description: See experiment-envelope.schema.json. Drives one independent sub-check of environment_consistency.

binary_sha256.description: See experiment-envelope.schema.json. Drives one independent sub-check of environment_consistency.

weight_sha256.description: See experiment-envelope.schema.json. Drives one independent sub-check of environment_consistency.

validity.description: See experiment-envelope.schema.json. Pure passthrough echo; never feeds this run's own computed validity.

schema_version.description: The shared envelope contract's own version tag (see experiment-envelope.schema.json) - distinct from manifest_schema_version above.

config_sha256.description: Not part of the shared envelope - veridict-specific. Opaque hash of whatever run configuration doesn't live in a hashed artifact file (time control, thread count, search depth, etc.). Drives one independent sub-check of environment_consistency, closing the 'no mid-run config change' check.

schedule.description: Declared first-occurrence order of gated pair ids. Drives the schedule_order check against games.jsonl's actual order (excluding any record with include_in_gate: false).
